[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads tokens and prints a fixed sequence of probing lines, records a next-expected counter for three input groups while tracking the group with the smallest response length, then uses that information to emit final verification queries and flush stdout." solve]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> in </REF>: Scanner "Scanner over the input source; the method consumes tokens from it and writes responses to stdout."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND For i from 1 through 17 inclusive, read and discard one input token, then print to stdout the string formed by i followed by " 100". RESULT void]
            [COMMAND For i from 1 through 68 inclusive, read and discard one input token, print to stdout the string formed by ((i % 17) + 1) followed by a space and i, then flush stdout after each printed line. RESULT void]
            [COMMAND Initialize res as a String array of length 3, num as an int array of length 3, m to 1000, and ind to 0. RESULT state]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to 2 inclusive, read and discard one input token, then print to stdout the string formed by (18 + i) followed by " 0". RESULT void]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop over i, read the next integer from input and assign it to n. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop over i, set p to 1. RESULT p]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop over i, for k starting at 0 while k < n, read an integer t from input, and if t equals p, increment p. RESULT p]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop over i, if n is less than m, set m to n and set ind to i. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop over i, store the final value of p into num[i]. RESULT num]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to 3 inclusive, and for each j from 0 to 2 inclusive, if j is not equal to ind, read and discard one input token and print to stdout the string formed by (18 + j) followed by a space and num[j]. RESULT void]
            [COMMAND Read and discard one input token, then print to stdout "19 0". RESULT void]
            [COMMAND Read the next integer from input and assign it to n. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND For i starting at 0 while i < n, read and discard one input token. RESULT void]
            [COMMAND For i from 18 through 20 inclusive, read and discard one input token and print to stdout the string formed by i followed by " 100". RESULT void]
            [COMMAND Flush stdout using System.out.flush(). RESULT void]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
